competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and deals damage proportionate to your Defense. Each attack has a 25% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn. If the target is not suffering any harmful effects, 1 additional attack is added.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: If the target is not suffering any harmful effects

competences.description: Unleashes a devastating shout which has a 50% chance to provoke the enemy for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Your damage is increased according to the number of attacks you have received. The damage increase will reset when you attack an enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: Increased according to the number of attacks you have received. The damage increase will reset when you attack an enemy
